story.title: The Memory Tenant
story.logline: A young archivist discovers the stranger living in her memories is paying rent with her happiest days.
story.theme: The cost of emotional real estate
story.twist: She is not the landlord of her mind; she is the eviction notice.
story.ending: Who is currently living in your best moments?

scenes.narration: My first memory vanished at midnight. Just a blank void where my eighth birthday cake used to burn brightly.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 22-year-old woman with messy brown hair and a green sweater stands in a dimly lit archive room, looking shocked.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on her wide eyes, rapid push in

scenes.narration: I found a tiny digital receipt stamped inside my own cerebral cortex. Someone had paid to store their grief here.
scenes.visual_prompt: 22-year-old woman with messy brown hair and a green sweater staring at a glowing holographic receipt floating in front of her face.
scenes.camera: Medium shot, tracking her panicked hand movement

scenes.narration: A strange man's childhood now occupies the sunny corner of my mind where my mother's laughter used to echo.
scenes.visual_prompt: 22-year-old woman with messy brown hair and a green sweater holding her head, background shifting slightly with a ghostly blue hue.
scenes.camera: Dutch angle, slow orbit around her

scenes.narration: I tried to evict him. I screamed into my own thoughts, demanding my stolen joy back from the intruder.
scenes.visual_prompt: 22-year-old woman with messy brown hair and a green sweater shouting silently, tears welling, in the dimly lit archive room.

scenes.narration: His voice whispered back from the dark, explaining that my brain was the only empty space left on the market.
scenes.visual_prompt: 22-year-old woman with messy brown hair and a green sweater looking terrified as a shadow falls across her face in the archive room.
scenes.camera: Low angle looking up at her

scenes.narration: He pays a fortune in borrowed bliss, trading his heavy sorrow for my sunlit afternoon fields of wheat.
scenes.visual_prompt: 22-year-old woman with messy brown hair and a green sweater blinking slowly as golden wheat fields flash briefly in her eyes.
scenes.camera: Split screen effect, blending her face with a sunny field

scenes.narration: Then I checked the property deed registered deep inside my brainstem. My name wasn't listed anywhere on it.
scenes.visual_prompt: 22-year-old woman with messy brown hair and a green sweater staring in horror at a glowing document hovering in the archive room.
scenes.camera: Push in, tight on her trembling lips

scenes.narration: I am not the owner of this skull. I am just the live-in caretaker keeping the lights on for someone else.
scenes.visual_prompt: 22-year-old woman with messy brown hair and a green sweater touching her temples, skin glowing faintly with digital code.

scenes.narration: Another payment cleared today. My first kiss was deleted, replaced by a stranger's quiet walk in the rain.
scenes.visual_prompt: 22-year-old woman with messy brown hair and a green sweater standing still as digital rain falls softly over her face indoors.

scenes.narration: The rent is due tomorrow. Who is currently living in your best moments?
scenes.visual_prompt: 22-year-old woman with messy brown hair and a green sweater staring directly into the camera lens with empty, hollow eyes.

caption.hook: Who is living in your happiest memories?
caption.title: The Memory Tenant
caption.caption:
She thought she rented out her mind for extra space. But every time he pays, another golden afternoon vanishes.

Turns out, she wasn't the landlord. She was the eviction notice.
